dog.description_text:
Remi is a beautiful 6-month-old (as of 8/25) female DSH with a gorgeous white and gray coat and an adorable personality to match! She is a sweet, playful girl who loves exploring her surroundings and is quickly showing everyone just how much personality she has.

Remi absolutely loves other cats and enjoys having feline friends around to play and interact with. She is also comfortable around dogs and does well sharing her space with them. She has a fun, playful side that is really starting to shine, and she loves treats and Churu—always a great way to win her heart!

Remi is litterbox trained and ready for a loving home where she can continue to blossom. She would make a wonderful addition to a family looking for a playful, sweet companion who enjoys having other animals around.

With her beautiful coloring, sweet nature, and playful personality, Remi is sure to be a wonderful addition to her forever family!

If you would like to adopt Remi please visit our website at www.pupstarzrescue.org.
